Cricket pitch: ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman theek beech mein ruka; us jagah ka bhi number hai. Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Line ki doosri taraf 3 barabar gaps hain. Wahan pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Line ki doosri taraf 3 barabar gaps hain. Wahan pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: 3 sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Sadak 0 se 1 kilometre, 7 barabar gaps mein kati hai. Ek khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh ek pakki jagah hai, uska number 1/7 kilometre. Doosri taraf wahi sadak, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein hai. Khilona wahan pehle mark par ruka: kitne kilometre par?
director.card: Doosri taraf wahi sadak, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein hai. Khilona wahan pehle mark par ruka: kitne kilometre par?

Ab line ki doosri taraf dekho: wahan 7 marks hain, sab ek-doosre se barabar door. Us taraf kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, marks se gaps ek zyada: 7 marks, 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Gap zyada, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se ek gap door. Line ki doosri taraf wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/10 wala

Bilkul sahi: 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas. Ab ek sawaal milkar, ek-ek kadam karke dekhte hain. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par hain. 3 khambe raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, ek-ek kadam karke dekhte hain.

director.text: Nahi, yeh nahi hai. 3 khambe raaste ko 4 barabar gaps mein kaatte hain: ghar se pehle khambe tak ek gap, aur aakhri khambe se school tak bhi ek. Doori gaps se naapte hain, khambon se nahi: khamba bas ek jagah hai, aur ghar se pehle khambe tak ka chalna ek gap hai. Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?

Is baar line 3 barabar gaps mein kati hai, har gap 1/3. 0 se 2 gap chalo, ek, do, aur hum 2/3 par aa gaye. 2/3 ek hi jagah hai, ek hi number. Line ki doosri taraf 8 barabar gaps hain. 0 se 5 gap chalo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?

Teeno gap milkar 0 se 1 tak ki poori line bhar dete hain. Ab socho, line 1/5 wale gaps mein kati hai. 0 se theek 1 tak aise kitne gap chalne honge?

Haan, sahi hai: 1/5 ke 5 gap milkar 5/5 banate hain, aur 5/5 = 1. Ab line ke 6 barabar gaps hain. Theek beech ka mark 3/6 hai, aur 3, 6 ka aadha hai, toh 3/6 = 1/2. 2/6 beech se pehle aata hai, 5/6 beech ke baad. Isi line par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Beech wale mark 3/6 se shuru karo. 4/6 tak pahunchne ke liye kis taraf ek gap chalna padega, woh dekho. Is line par 4/6 beech se pehle aayega, ya beech ke baad?
director.card: Isi line par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?

director.text: before the middle

Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Roti ke 6 barabar hisse socho: 3 hisse le lo toh theek aadhi roti hai, isliye 3/6 = 1/2 beech mein hai. 2 hisse aadhi se kam hain, toh 2/6 beech se pehle, aur 5 hisse aadhi se zyada, toh 5/6 beech ke baad. Isi line par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki beech 3/6 par hai, aur upar wala number 4 usse ek zyada hai, toh ek gap aage, beech ke baad. Aao, agla sawaal hum dono mil ke hal karenge. Ek number line 0 se 1 tak hai. Is par 2/5 ka mark dhoondhna hai. 2/5 ke liye is line ka har gap kitne ka hoga?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal hum dono mil ke hal karenge.

director.text: Yeh jawab nahi hai. 2/5 ka neeche wala number 5 hai, toh 0 se 1 ki line 5 barabar gaps mein kategi, aur har gap 1/5 ka hai. Ab 0 se 1/5 ka ek-ek gap chalte hain; har gap ke ant par ek mark aata hai. Tumhari baari: 2/5 ke liye 0 ke baad kaunse mark par rukoge?

Har 1/8 kilometre par patthar hai. Khilona teesre patthar par hai: board par us jagah ko ek number mein kaise likhoge?

director.text: one

Sahi jawab, kyunki 3/4 akela ek number hai, toh line par uski sirf ek jagah hai: 0 se 3 gap chalkar, wahi ek mark. Ab fraction 1 ke aage bhi jaayenge: line kabhi 2 tak chalegi, kabhi 3 tak, aur dekhenge ki 1 se bade fraction kahan aate hain. Yahan tak saaf hai?
thak gayi, bye
Thak jaana theek hai; thoda aaram karo aur paani pi lo. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge.
